name: motionhaus
description: Motionhaus: an AI video studio. Launch films (LaunchReel), daily Shorts channels (Launch Radar), Instagram reel edits of real footage, edit styles, a Remotion motion kit and a pre-delivery QA gate.

scripts.studio:install: npm --prefix apps/shorts/studio install && npm --prefix apps/reels/studio install
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm --prefix apps/shorts/studio run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/reels/studio run typecheck
scripts.test: npm test --workspaces && npm --prefix apps/shorts/studio test && npm --prefix apps/reels/studio test

author: Suryansh Chaudhary
